entries.name: Kigurumi Mask
entries.content: The face masks are usually faces of anime characters. the mask allows a similar level of facial features, mostly displaying a smile. The masks are usually two parters, full head models, encasing the the full head of the person, even having hair attached. They are basically a second head to put on. The normal head isnt visible while wearing the mask. The masks usualy have the back of the head as base. After the base is put on, the front side of the mask will get attached to it. The front has then to be flipped down onto the face to complete the mask. These masks have dildo gags attached and can also be locked to the head with padlocks.

entries.name: Kigurumi
entries.content: By wearing a body suit and mask, kigurumi cosplayers are able to closer resemble the characters with high accuracy. In kigurumi, the performers wear a plastic facemask that was created by either molding or 3D printing and a matching flesh-coloured body suit (a zentai suit known as a hadatai) or a black latex suit.
